name: Waku Ghin
address: The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands, Level 2 Dining, L2-03, 10 Bayfront Avenue, Singapore 018956
dinnerNote: Chef's Table degustation menu (Five at Five menu S$250)
dinnerNoteZh: 主廚餐桌品嚐套餐（Five at Five 套餐 S$250）

menus.name: Chef's Table degustation menu
menus.note: At the 10-seat Chef's Table, daily at 5pm and 7.30pm. Reservations only.

menus.name: Five at Five Chef's Table menu
menus.note: A shorter Chef's Table menu with Canadian lobster and Omi wagyu, daily 5pm to 7pm from 19 October 2026.

menus.name: Signature Prelude menu
menus.note: In the bar or main dining room, until 18 October 2026, alongside an à la carte menu.

bookingOpens: Online through Marina Bay Sands' booking page, or by phone. The Chef's Table has two seatings a night, at 5pm and 7.30pm; the bar and main dining room take bookings in 30-minute slots from 5pm to 9.30pm.
walkIns: The bar serves à la carte dishes and cocktails from 5pm daily; its seasonal fruit cocktails are for walk-ins only.
groups: The main dining room takes groups of up to 8; larger groups need to contact the restaurant. A private dining room seats up to 8 for an omakase menu, best booked a month ahead.
dressCode: Smart casual. Men are asked to wear collared shirts or smart T-shirts with trousers or tailored shorts and closed-toe shoes. No slippers, flip-flops, singlets, swimwear or gym wear; guests not dressed to the code may be turned away.
children: Children under 10 are not allowed in. Older children must come with an adult and follow the dress code. There's no children's menu.
